verses.text: The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
I have filled him with the Spirit of Dumnezeu, in wisdom, and in understanding, and in knowledge, and in all kinds of workmanship, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
to devise skillful works, to work in să pleceld, and in silver, and in bronze,
and in cutting of stones for setting, and in carving of wood, to work in all kinds of workmanship. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Behold, I myself have appointed with him Oholiab, the son of Ahisamach, of the tribe of Dan; and in the heart of all who are wise-hearted I have put wisdom, that they may make all that I have commanded you: (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the table and its vessels, the pure lamp stand with all its vessels, the altar of incense, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the altar of burnt offering with all its vessels, the basin and its base, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the finely worked garments—the holy garments for Aaron the priest, the garments of his sons to minister in the priest’s office— (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
the anointing oil, and the incense of sweet spices for the holy place: according to all that I have commanded you they shall do. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
The DOMNUL a vorbit lui Moise, saying, (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Speak also to the children of Israel, saying, ‘Most certainly you shall keep my Sabbaths; for it is a sign between me and you throughout your generations, that you may know that Eu sunt the DOMNUL who sanctifies you. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

You shall keep the Sabbath therefore, for it is holy to you. Everyone who profanes it shall surely be put to death; for whoever does any work therein, that soul shall be cut off from among his people. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

Six days shall work be done, but on the seventh day is a Sabbath of solemn rest, holy to the DOMNUL. Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day shall surely be put to death. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
Therefore the children of Israel shall keep the Sabbath, to observe the Sabbath throughout their generations, for a perpetual covenant. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)

It is a sign between me and the children of Israel forever; for in six days the DOMNUL made heaven and earth, and on the seventh day he rested, and was refreshed.’  (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
When he finished speaking with him on Mount Sinai, he gave Moise the two tablets of the covenant, stone tablets, written with Dumnezeu’s finger. (text revizuit în limba română cu diacritice)
